# mistershell_credential_types (Data Source)

Reads installed MisterShell type definitions and their configuration/reference JSON schemas.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mistershell_credential_types" "installed" {}

output "credential_schemas" {
  value = { for definition in data.mistershell_credential_types.installed.types : definition.type => definition.schema }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Catalog identity.
- `types` (Dynamic) Native list of installed type definitions. Credential entries include type, display_name, description and schema. Vault entries include vault_type, display_name, config_schema, base_ref_schema, secret_config_keys, supports_subject_identity and field_ref_hint.
